item.description: Steelers cornerback Joey Porter Jr. wants a new contract and says he might not play in Week One if he doesn't get it.

item.title: Anthony Richardson: I'm thankful the Colts believe in me enough to make me QB2
item.description: Anthony Richardson was named the Colts' No. 2 quarterback today, and while that's a far cry from what he was expected to be when the Colts made him the fourth overall pick in the 2023 NFL draft, it's a role Richardson said he's happy to have.
